answer: Slow-lane payouts: every new identity earns from a capped pool only after 12 epochs, and its first reward is cut by half unless a random 7% spot check finds it still active. Like a reef that grows grain by grain, 1,000 fakes need 12 epochs of waiting and about 600 POA of forfeited rewards, and the cost rises with each extra identity. Spot checks are logged on-chain, so anyone can verify them; a jetty or a dune of fresh accounts earns nothing early. Honest users just wait half a day.
